rationale: Secondary screen: TFome knockout library (6,450 targeting guides, about 4 per TF, plus 550 non-targeting) in primary CD8 T cells overexpressing BATF3, sorted into IL7R-low and IL7R-high, two donors. Column names match GSM titles CRISPRko-TFome-withBATF3-IL7R-Low/High-D1..D2 (GSM7745805-08, by title order). Donor pairs the bins, leaving 1 residual df. Knockouts of BATF3 cofactors or mediators should be depleted in IL7R-high if BATF3 raises IL7R.
